name: Family-balanced boundary consensus v1
inputs: Original V18 pinned voters, including HDJoJo V1; no updated-direct or complement changes
mechanism: Keep original instance identities and counts; replace only boundaries with equal-family pixel majority. Average correlated UNet masks inside their one family. On exact half ties preserve base pixels.
matching: Mutual-best IoU strictly above 0.5 between each source and base instances; at least three distinct families; exactly three requires all supporting IoUs at least 0.6

guards.family_mean_iou: must strictly improve and must not reduce number of families matching above0.5
guards.simultaneous_expansion_conflicts: roll back every involved instance, never resolve by source order

limitations: Unlabeled mask-geometry experiment. Agreement is not accuracy. No independent held validation and no claim to reproduce underlying model weights. Original public0.40 control retained.
